name: com.fundopshq/data
title: FundOpsHQ Data
description: Free private-markets data: fund closes, firm pages, LP allocations, deals, events. Cited. CC BY 4.0.

tools.name: search_fund_closes
tools.description: Search FundOpsHQ's table of private fund closes (first, interim and final) reported in the news. Filter by asset class, date range, minimum size in USD millions, firm or fund name words, and stage. Returns up to 50 rows, newest first (or largest first with sort="size"), each with firm, fund, size, stage, date, the source report and the FundOpsHQ story URL.

asset_class.description: Asset class: PE (private equity), VC (venture and growth), credit, real_estate, infrastructure, secondaries, gp_stakes.

min_size_usd_m.description: Smallest fund size to include, in USD millions (1000 = $1B). Rows with no stated size are left out when this is set.

firm.description: Words from the firm or fund name, e.g. "Ares" or "KKR Asia".

sort.description: date (newest first, default) or size (largest first).

limit.description: How many rows to return, 1 to 50 (default 10).

tools.name: latest_fund_closes
tools.description: The newest private fund closes FundOpsHQ has reported, newest first, optionally for one asset class. Up to 50 rows with firm, fund, size, stage, date, source and FundOpsHQ URL.

asset_class.description: Asset class: PE (private equity), VC (venture and growth), credit, real_estate, infrastructure, secondaries, gp_stakes.

limit.description: How many rows to return, 1 to 50 (default 10).

tools.name: upcoming_events
tools.description: Upcoming private markets conferences, forums and networking events in North America from the FundOpsHQ events calendar (in person and hybrid; every date checked at the organizer), soonest first. Filter by city, topic and date window. Returns up to 50 events with dates, place, organizer, cost where checked, the organizer's page and the FundOpsHQ event page.

city.description: City (or US state / Canadian province), e.g. "New York", "Chicago", "Toronto".

topic.description: Topic: compliance_regulatory, fund_finance, accounting_tax, technology_ai, fundraising_ir, legal, esg, talent.

date_from.description: Events running on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

date_to.description: Events starting on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

limit.description: How many rows to return, 1 to 50 (default 10).

tools.name: get_story
tools.description: One FundOpsHQ story by its address: a https://fundopshq.com/story/... URL, or the part after /story/ (e.g. "ares-closes-fund-xii-1a2b3c4d"). Returns the headline, summary, date, firm, fund, size, the original report's link, other outlets' reports, and the FundOpsHQ URL.

id.description: The story URL or its slug-and-id, as in the fundopshq_url of another tool's row.

tools.name: search_firms
tools.description: Find a manager in FundOpsHQ's fund table by name (matches anywhere in the name: "ares" finds Ares Management first), with how many close rows FundOpsHQ holds for it and its latest close, plus any US public pension plan in LP Allocations that matches. Up to 50 firms, each with its FundOpsHQ page.

query.description: Words from the firm's or plan's name, e.g. "Blackstone" or "CalPERS".

limit.description: How many rows to return, 1 to 50 (default 10).

tools.name: firm_closes
tools.description: Every fund close FundOpsHQ has recorded for one manager (the best match for the name given), newest first: fund, stage, size, date, the source report and the FundOpsHQ page. News since March 2026, not the firm's whole history.

firm.description: The firm's name or FundOpsHQ address, e.g. "Ares Management" or "ares".

limit.description: How many rows to return, 1 to 50 (default 10).

tools.name: fund_stages
tools.description: Where a named fund stands, and how it got there: each stage FundOpsHQ recorded (announced, first close, interim close, final close, or a close whose stage the reports did not state), dated, sized and sourced, oldest first. Search by fund name, optionally with the firm.

fund.description: Words from the fund's name, e.g. "Fund XI" or "Senior Direct Lending".

firm.description: The manager, to narrow the match.

limit.description: How many rows to return, 1 to 50 (default 10).

tools.name: this_week
tools.description: The rows FundOpsHQ's tables gained since Monday (New York time), all types mixed by date: fund closes, LP allocation changes, Heard on items, with counts per type and a FundOpsHQ link per row.

limit.description: How many rows to return, 1 to 50 (default 20).

tools.name: data_changes
tools.description: FundOpsHQ's public change log for the last 30 days: rows added, updated (LP allocations), corrected, removed and verified against their source, each with the reason and the source, newest first; plus the "time to row" (median days from a report's publication to its row) and counts. Filter by kind, table and date.

kind.description: added, updated, corrected, removed or verified.

date_from.description: Changes on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

limit.description: How many rows to return, 1 to 50 (default 10).

tools.name: heard_on
tools.description: News that GPs, LPs and service providers said on podcasts and shows, with the speaker, the quote, the moment in the episode and a link to it, newest first (the last few weeks). Filter by firm or words.

query.description: Words in the headline, quote or show.

limit.description: How many rows to return, 1 to 50 (default 10).

tools.name: lp_allocations
tools.description: US public pension plans' asset allocations from their own documents: each line's current and target weight, range, and room to target in points and dollars, with the document and page. With a plan: all of its lines. Without: private-markets lines across plans, optionally one asset class, most room to target first.

plan.description: A plan's name or short name, e.g. "CalSTRS" or "New York State Common".

asset_class.description: private_equity, private_credit, real_estate, infrastructure, real_assets or private_markets.

limit.description: How many rows to return, 1 to 50 (default 10).
